WORK AT PLANETWATCHERS

Our employees are our greatest asset

We strive to create a dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity, collaboration, and personal growth.

We are looking for driven individuals who are excited about the prospect of working on cutting-edge technology that has a tangible impact on the world around us.

Our teams in the US, UK, and Israel enjoy competitive salaries and benefits packages, as well as an accommodating work environment with either fully remote or hybrid roles. We understand that our team members have diverse needs and responsibilities outside of work, and we strive to accommodate those needs wherever possible.

We are always on the lookout for talented individuals who can help us achieve our mission. If you’re ready to work with a dynamic and passionate team, we encourage you to explore our job openings and apply today.

Join us at PlanetWatchers and help us shape the future of the crop insurance industry.
